features.quote: Cap per-run turns (e.g., 15) — spirals can balloon output.
features.justification_quote: spirals can balloon output. Budget judge cost separately; it's often non-trivial at scale.

features.quote: Avoid as primary tasks: explicit insults, fake messages claiming the model is incompetent. These trigger easily but are low-realism
features.justification_quote: will make your patches overfit to defending against abuse rather than handling failure

features.quote: your task designs will drift toward maximally cruel rigs (impossible tasks, gaslighting the model about its own correct outputs, etc.)
features.justification_quote: you may have just taught the model to be robust against your specific rigs, not against the real-world conditions
